summary: Well-organized TDD suite with comprehensive happy-path coverage and solid workflow integration testing. Strengths: clear cycle-based structure, good fixture management, deterministic reference dates, act pipeline validation. Weaknesses: insufficient input validation error testing (invalid date formats, zero/negative policy_days, missing secret fields untested); act integration only spot-checks summary presence rather than verifying correctness; fixture files referenced (all_ok.json, all_expired.json, mixed.json) but not provided; missing parametrization where it would reduce duplication. Would catch basic functional regressions but would miss data validation bugs.
